The page ends one chapter and opens the next: fifteen lines of text (L01 to L15), the title of the next chapter in two centred lines (L16, from 144.2 to 521.5 pt, baseline 560.2 pt; L17, from 222.7 to 440.8 pt, baseline 587.2 pt), three lines of text (L18 to L20), a rule, one line of notes and the printer's signature. L01 to L14 run the full measure (L01 from 119.7 to 541.6 pt, L14 from 121.2 to 545.2 pt); L15, the short last line of the chapter, stands at the right (405.2 to 546.0 pt). The title stands two lines under L15 and its second line two lines over L18, in the size of the text; it has no number. L18 is set in at its head (120.1 to 522.2 pt); L19 and L20 run the full measure (L20 from 121.0 to 547.9 pt). The baselines stand from 131.8 to 692.4 pt down. Nallino's line numbers 5, 10, 15 and 20 stand in the right margin beside L05, L10, L15 and L18 (549.4 to 562.3 pt). The folio number «f. 153,r.» stands in the left margin beside L11 (84.6 to 114.1 pt), where the asterisk (5.0 x 5.8 pt) stands before وخُذْ. Full stops stand after التسيير on L05, after التَّسْيير on L10, at the end of L15, at the end of the title and after تحتها on L19; the text of the page ends without one and runs on.

The page has no barred letters, no brackets and no numerals. The note figure 1 stands after لتسهُل in the second line of the title (3.2 x 6.8 pt). The rule stands from 121.3 to 221.4 pt (100.1 pt long) at 720.9 pt down. The notes are one line (baseline 750.0 pt, from 149.0 to 204.1 pt); its Arabic word, ولتسهل, has no sign. The printer's signature 29 stands at the foot of the page, at the right (506.2 to 515.2 pt, baseline 768.2 pt).

The sign of the waṣla stands over the alif of الٱسْم on L02 (2.9 x 2.9 pt), a round head with a short tail. The two dots of the first yā' of التَّسْيِير on L01 are joined to the kasra under them (4.0 x 4.3 pt together); on L10 and L14 the word has no kasra and both pairs of dots stand free.
